summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, Levels 1–5 and M.E.G. Base Gamma, combining authored scenes with place simulations and shared survival, creature and NPC systems. Players scavenge, fight, build and talk; Level 5's hotel includes residents, rentals and playable mahjong, while wait/sleep advances a shared world clock.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, loot, shifting walls, seeded moments, smilers and lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, rooms, NPCs, supplies, hounds and Level 3 threshold.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze/crawl halls, hazards, loot, creature brigades, Gamma checkpoint, rare Samantha/Death Rat visits and lifts to Levels 4/5.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards, residents and locked Database terminal.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; offices, fountains, break-room vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega; sim lays residents, office systems and tasks.
places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel; authored Main Hall, guest rooms, Beverly Room ballroom and Boiler Room; residents, elevator banks, hostile staff, Death Rats, rentals and playable mahjong.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain: locomotion, player, interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick, horde, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch, eye position, computer view, seated eye and third-person death view.
places/<place>/sim.js - local setup/tick roots; place simulations assemble geometry, residents, encounters and exits; Level 4/5 sims also lay systems.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; Level 3 objects.scene hosts visits, Level 5 x0z0.scene hosts hotel fixtures, cast and managers.
places/level5/config.yaml - dark, fogged hotel environment, colored sky, warm ambient light and scripts/look-level5.js post-processing.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD, transition card and loot/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/horde/noclip/lockpick/wait/mahjong overlays.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + level0 data, scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with data - per-level grids/layouts reused by sims, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + level3 data + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim, creatures and visits.
scripts/lib/level4.js and scripts/lib/level5.js - office/hotel plans, zones, openings, exits and sanity data shared by geometry, place systems and player.js.
scripts/lib/l5-hall-layout.js + l5-hall-kit.js and scripts/lib/l5-boiler-plan.js - hotel furnishing/door plan and boiler coordinates shared by geometry and active lay/heat scripts.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml; scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml - NPC definitions, rounds, speech and simulation helpers for the corresponding place systems.
scripts/lib/l5-hostile.js + l5-entities.json and scripts/lib/witness.js - hostile safe-zone/prey/damage/remains helpers and kill witness/reputation handling shared by staff, rats, visits and combat.

scripts/lib/clock.js, scripts/lib/hear.js, scripts/lib/npc-starters.js - shared game-time, wall-occluded spatial sound and dialogue starters/choices consumed by rest/residents, sound callers and talk.js respectively.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4/5 also export lay; places/gamma/sim.js exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level4.js - office room/zone constants and queries; scripts/lib/level5.js - T, ZONES, OPENINGS, EXITS, ARRIVALS, ELEVATORS, BOILER and hotel queries.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js - PEOPLE5, roundsOf, speak, spawnResident, tickPeople; scripts/l5-elevator.js - destIndex, ears, update; scripts/l5-people.js - schedule/update.
scripts/lib/l5-hostile.js - safe-zone, prey, hit, remains and hostile data helpers; scripts/lib/witness.js - markKill; scripts/lib/breakables.js - damage/sync/sweep helpers.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - clothing/look/roll helpers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - critter model/look/morph helpers; scripts/lib/seat.js - seat claims/sit/stand.
scripts/lib/clock.js - DAY_MS, HOUR_MS, gameNow, clockOf; scripts/lib/hear.js - heard; scripts/lib/npc-starters.js - STARTERS, GENERIC_STARTERS, getStarter, getChoices.
scripts/lib/mahjong.js - SUITS, fullSet, sortHand, isWin, worth, NAMES; scripts/mahjong-ui.js - mahjongPanel; scripts/mahjong.js - onInput; scripts/rest.js - onInput.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, hunger/thirst, cash (cents), visited areas, kills/deaths and combat; movement consumes carryMul from grab.js.
scripts/stats.js - player.state HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state craftOpen/craftBench and payout redemption; recipes validate skill/materials; craft also owns hunger/thirst drain and food/water use.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing; spawned creature state carries owner horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - focus/loot/interaction and player sit state; seats own by-occupancy claims, NPCs own pockets/pickpocket reactions, containers own item/lock/scavenged state.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/talk.js - interaction sets player.state.talkWith; talk owns shopOpen, talkBusy, talkChoices and session talkingTo; talk-ui.js presents this state.

scripts/grab.js and scripts/mahjong.js - grab session owns held object/physics and heave state; player state carries carry/carryMul; player.state.mj owns the table game, with cents debited/awarded by play.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered handlers: locomotion precedes player movement; interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick and horde process their actions before critter behavior.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; player/enemy gaze and targeting read camera; seats and sit state lower seated view.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; Level 3 sim lifts → Levels 4/5, Level 4 stairs → Level 5; hotel lift/stairs return to Level 3/4.
scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; Level 3/4/5 sims place inbound markers, while player.js selects safe spawn/door checkpoints after death.
scripts/player.js writes player.state.xfer on place change → scripts/ui.js draws named transition card; level-door crossing emits black transition and threshold sound.

interact.js E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js submits numbered dialogue choices, free text or Trade/Goodbye → talk.js/NPC ears; talk.js loads npc-starters.js for greetings/choices and updates dialogue state; its combat check closes talk on player/NPC damage, an active target or nearby foe.
interact.js E → door/container/bench/usable press; Level 4/5 handlers own their special use cases; E on lockpick-locked target starts lockpick.js and lockpick-ui.js renders it.
Level 4 phones/printers/shift board → l4-office.js tasks and player.state.l4task; completion writes payout, which craft.js redeems and craft-ui.js displays.

Level 5 l5-hall-mgr → l5-hall-lay.js reads hall layout and lays furnishings/guest leaves; l5-heat manager → l5-heat.js reads boiler plan, phases vents and writes player heat/hp; level5/sim.js registers breakables while excluding whole-room meshes.

Level 5 l5-people director → lib/l5-people.js reads level5-people.yml and maintains residents/suite storage; resident ears handle talk, rent/checkout, escorts and jobs; shared clock offset drives day/night rounds.
Level 3 objects.scene l3-visits manager → l3-visits.js reads visit data and Level 3 grid/path helpers; it spawns Samantha/Death Rat encounters whose outcomes use hostile and witness helpers.

T → rest.js opens wait UI; waitdo advances world.state.clockSkip, heals at a nearby bed and drains hunger/thirst; clock.js and resident routines read the shifted clock. Level 5 mahjong table press → l5-ball.js warning/re-entry → mahjong.js table state and mahjong-ui.js.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state; Level 5 x0z0.scene groups hotel detail by room tags.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office structure, non-colliding detail, varied abandoned props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambient sounds, tasks and supply rewards.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - agent/resident rounds and talk vary by faction, role, voice, look/build and day/night routine; scripts/meg-agent.js smooths routes, separates crowds and sidesteps stuck movement.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml - leveled garment lists vary by player/place tier and rarity; faction wardrobes roll for agents; Level 5 residents keep authored outfits.
scripts/smilers.js, lurkers.js, hounds.js and stealers.js - distinct pursuit/senses adapt to place grids, safe zones, gaze/light and hunt phase; deathmoths manage their own swarms.
scripts/l5-hall-lay.js + l5-hall-geo.js/l5-hall-fix.js - Main Hall furnishings/fixtures derive from layout rows; kind and loot metadata vary geometry, collision, breakability and containers.

Level 5 elevator banks reuse behavior with copper/modern/freight geometry; l5-staff.js disguises facelings as hotel figures, l5-rats.js manages packs, while grab.js shares lift/throw/break behavior across eligible props.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m (hub cells 26–29); Level 1 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 64×64 m with 8 m offices; Level 5 96×60 m, x ±48/z ±30.
Level 4 base l4-geo is structural mesh/collider; l4-detail-geo draws non-colliding ceiling/carpet/wall wear; props and scene/sim bodies supply collision.
Level 3 tight cells clear width 1 m (tightHalf 0.5), springline 1.6 m and crown 2.15 m; tightArms/tightSpans drive vaults and gates/furniture stay out of crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: locomotion, player, interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick, horde, critter; NPC chains likewise place locomotion before controllers.
Door IDs couple level-door.js PAIR, place arrival markers and player.js CHECKS; Level 5 routes include l3-lift5 ↔ l5-from-l3 and l4-stairs-down ↔ l5-from-l4, with lift/stairs returns.
world.state.clockSkip is milliseconds added to ctx.now() by gameNow; a day is 600000 ms and an hour 25000 ms. Rest advances the shared clock; Level 4 l4clock is separately adjusted, not replaced.
